description: Implementation of the ManagementGrain class for Orleans Runtime, providing management and diagnostic functionalities such as retrieving host statuses, forcing garbage collection, collecting runtime statistics, and managing strategies and grain activations.

classes.name: ManagementGrain
classes.description: Implementation class for the Orleans management grain, offering various management and diagnostic operations.

methods.name: GetHosts
methods.description: Retrieves current silo host statuses, optionally filtering for active silos only.

methods.name: GetDetailedHosts
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about silo hosts, optionally filtering for active silos only.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection on specified silos.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Forces activation collection on specified silos, with an optional age limit.

methods.name: ForceRuntimeStatisticsCollection
methods.description: Collects runtime statistics from specified silos.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics from specified silos.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves simple grain statistics from specified silos or all active silos.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves detailed grain statistics, optionally filtered by types and hosts.

methods.name: GetGrainActivationCount
methods.description: Counts activations for a specific grain reference across silos.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for the system or specific grain interfaces.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the version selector strategy for the system or specific grain interfaces.

methods.name: GetTotalActivationCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of grain activations across all silos.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Sends a control command to a grain provider.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Finds the silo activation address for a given grain reference.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Retrieves list of active grain IDs of a specific type.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Retrieves call frequency data between grains across silos.

methods.name: ResetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Resets grain call counters across specified silos.
